data.short_meaning: Tatiana means 'to bear, to endure' in Greek and 'to carry, to hold' in Latin.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Tatiana was a martyr who was tortured and died for her faith in Christ. The name is derived from the Greek word 'titanos', meaning 'to bear, to endure'.
